about: Spec 3.10.0 (acp.md, `session/cancel`): which turn a cancel touches. `turn`: the `_meta.lembas.turnId` the cancel carries, absent for ACP's own cancel; `running`: the id of the turn that runs in the session now, absent when none does; `queued`: the ids of the prompts waiting their turn. The result `cancelled` is what the device answers a cancel sent as a request: `running` — the running turn is stopped; `queued` — that prompt is taken out of the queue and answered `cancelled`, and the running turn is not touched; `none` — nothing is done. `stops`: the id of the turn stopped, `withdraws`: the id taken out of the queue (each absent when none). LLeMbas: what it may expect of a device with `harness_turns`; CLI: acp/turns.ts `cancelOf`.

cases.about: No id, a turn runs: ACP's cancel — the running turn, whoever started it.
No id, nothing runs: nothing to stop.
The turn named is the one that runs: stopped.
The turn named waits behind a harness turn: taken out of the queue; the harness turn is not touched.
Two prompts wait; the second is named: only it goes.
The turn named finished already, while another runs: nothing is done — the running turn is somebody else's.
An id the session never heard of, nothing running: nothing is done.
